passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My older sister is fifteen, and she has long hair.
phrases.ko: 나의 언니는 열다섯 살이고, 머리가 길어요.
phrases.zh: 我的姐姐十五岁，她有长头发。
phrases.py: wǒ de jiě jiě shí wǔ suì， tā yǒu cháng tóu fa。

phrases.en: She loves music, and she is kind to me.
phrases.py: tā ài yīn yuè， duì wǒ hěn shàn liáng。

phrases.en: We like to read a book together.
phrases.ko: 우리는 함께 책을 읽는 것을 좋아해요.
phrases.py: wǒ men xǐ huān yì qǐ kàn shū。

phrases.en: We play together on the weekend.
phrases.py: zhōu mò wǒ men yì qǐ wán。

phrases.en: I love my sister, and she loves me too.
phrases.ko: 나는 언니를 사랑하고, 언니도 나를 사랑해요.
phrases.py: wǒ ài jiě jiě， tā yě ài wǒ。

phrases.en: She helps me when my homework is hard.
phrases.zh: 作业难的时候，她帮助我。
phrases.py: zuò yè nán de shí hòu， tā bāng zhù wǒ。

phrases.en: Her long hair is black and shiny.
phrases.ko: 언니의 긴 머리는 검고 윤이 나요.
phrases.py: tā de cháng tóu fa yòu hēi yòu liàng。

phrases.en: She listens to music in her room.
phrases.zh: 她在自己的房间听音乐。
phrases.py: tā zài zì jǐ de fáng jiān tīng yīn yuè。

phrases.en: I am thirteen, so she is two years older.
phrases.ko: 나는 열세 살이니 언니는 두 살 더 많아요.
phrases.zh: 我十三岁，所以她比我大两岁。
phrases.py: wǒ shí sān suì， suǒ yǐ tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì。

phrases.en: We also play with our little sister.
phrases.zh: 我们也会和妹妹一起玩。
phrases.py: wǒ men yě huì hé mèi mèi yì qǐ wán。

phrases.en: A kind sister makes home feel warm.
phrases.zh: 善良的姐姐让家变得温暖。
phrases.py: shàn liáng de jiě jiě ràng jiā biàn de wēn nuǎn。

full_passage_spoken: My older sister is fifteen, and she has long hair. She loves music, and she is kind to me. We like to read a book together. We play together on the weekend. I love my sister, and she loves me too. She helps me when my homework is hard. Her long hair is black and shiny. She listens to music in her room. I am thirteen, so she is two years older. We also play with our little sister. A kind sister makes home feel warm.
full_passage_zh: 我的姐姐十五岁，她有长头发。她爱音乐，对我很善良。我们喜欢一起看书。周末我们一起玩。我爱姐姐，她也爱我。作业难的时候，她帮助我。她的长头发又黑又亮。她在自己的房间听音乐。我十三岁，所以她比我大两岁。我们也会和妹妹一起玩。善良的姐姐让家变得温暖。
